02. Functional vs non-functional
requirements

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Functional requirements specify behavior; non-functional requirements specify qualities or
constraints, preferably measurable.

Jහාඳින්, ඉක්මනින් Jහහෝ ආරක්ෂිතව කරනවාද කියන එක.

A patient can book an appointment; 95% of booking requests should respond within 500 ms
under the agreed load.
Functional Book appointment · Non-functional · p95 ≤500 ms · Cancel booking · Accessibility · Read the diagram: Compare the responsibilities or tradeoffs in each group. · Jකාටස් JදJක් Jවනස සසඳන්න.

FR-01: User can book an available slot.
NFR-01: p95 latency ≤ 500 ms at 100 requests/s.

Expected result: Both statements can be verified; the second requires a specified workload and
measurement.

Q: How do you make an NFR testable?
A: Specify a metric, threshold and conditions, rather than saying only “fast” or “secure”.
